notes: Web 415 — DISPATCH-LINKS-SET-SITES (Nov 11, 2026). The dispatch's pins now land in the record's own site fields at save time, like he had it before: when a dispatch is assembled — dspBuildRecord on every create (the manual form save, an ingest suggestion loaded into the form, the busy-form suggestion save) and dspApplyEdit on every edit save — each site pair the record still leaves empty is filled from the pair its own notes label for it: the pair after 'Go Empty To' (the pair itself or the Maps ?q= link after the label) becomes the pickup lat/lng, the pair after 'Hauling To' becomes the dump dumpLat/dumpLng, never a pair from past the other label, and an unlabelled pair is not a pin. A stored pin always wins — only a pair whose both coordinates are blank is filled, and a half-set pair is left exactly as it stands. Web 414's Navigate notes fallback is untouched; what changes is that the Dump-only door (which reads only the stored dump fields, so a notes-only dispatch showed no Dump-only button) and the load counter's site pegs now work from real pegs on the record. Nothing else changed — counting logic, the Navigator and every other screen are untouched. Bench: tools/dispatch-links-set-sites-v415-test.js — on web 414 the Nov 11 entry saved through the real save path came back with both field pairs empty and its saved record rendered no Dump-only door (24/40, the defect reproduced); on 415 the same save sets both pairs to the exact pins on both stored copies, the Dump-only door renders and routes to the Hauling To pin, Navigate routes to the Go Empty pin, an edit save sets the fields the same way, stored pins are never overwritten, the labels rule over position, links-only and hauling-only notes behave, a half-set pair is left alone, and the pasted-text ingest door lands the same fields end to end (41/41). Neighbour suites green (dispatch-ingest, dispatch-save 44/44, dispatch-navnotes-v414 30/30, navpin-crosscopy-v329, dispatch-edit 82/82, dispatch-close 79/79, dispatch-completed 65/65, close-confirm 58/58, queue-v173, web412-three-fixes, dispatch-send-screen-v378, loads-missed-dispatchpin, dispatch-tap-pti-gate, autostart-follow-dispatch-v342); the v150/v153/v154-era suites and dispatch-autostart/multi-send fail byte-identically on pristine 414 (stale version pins and old-era expectations, pre-existing). Verdict owed in Asjad's hands: a dispatch entered with its pins in the notes must show its Dump only button and count from its own pegs.
